Precision hits drain combatants' life force and charge up a ball of darkness. [Alternate Weapon Action]  and then fire to unleash the blight projectile, shrouding combatants in darkness and temporarily blinding them.

Precision Hits grant one stack of 'Charged With Blight'. 

At 10 stacks, hold [Reload] to load a 'Taken Blight'. 

Taken Blight deals <pve 208 /> <pvp [113] /> <arc/>Arc Damage on direct impact and corrupting field around it that poisons enemies and applies <arc/>Blind in a ? meter radius. Poison deals <pve 25 /> <pvp [0.375] /> <kinetic/>Kinetic Damage every 0.5 seconds for <pve 3.5 /> <pvp [2] /> seconds. 

Any target hit by the Blight takes 50% increased damage from all Weapons of Sorrow for 5 seconds.

Blight can benefit from the final round damage bonus.
